name: 立秋
operation: Byte-for-byte copy of selected built-in AI edit output; no crop, resize, upscaling or recompression

submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Refine one existing seasonal event banner; keep the native 2098 x 749 canvas, opaque edge-to-edge painting and exquisite original painted finish.
Reference image 1 is the approved event-midautumn.png: primary character, art style and refined volume reference. Reference image 2 is 01-mail-event.png: approved rendering quality only, never copy its UI, borders or text. Image 3 is the current Beginning of Autumn banner and the actual EDIT TARGET.
Preserve the boy in image 3 exactly: same face, golden headband, jade-and-ivory clothes, leaf in raised hand, woven basket with peaches and pears, golden yin-yang gourd, seated pose, two shoes and right-side position. Preserve the right stone ledge and the detailed painted forms.
Make one focused environment refinement: this is the FIRST gentle turn from summer to autumn, with a usable quiet title-overlay area on the left. Across the leftmost 45 percent, remove the near pavilion, boat, dock, bridge and all busy village details. Replace them with graceful distant soft blue-jade mountain silhouettes, a low mist band and smooth calm jade-blue lake with only sparse subtle horizontal reflections. Reduce the bright detailed cumulus clouds there to soft wisps. Keep the left visually spacious and low-contrast but still clearly a painted landscape, not a blank panel or a blur filter. Keep corner foliage sparse and mostly green.
Across the whole environment, return approximately 85 percent of tree foliage to summer jade-green; keep only a few first amber-yellow leaves on the top-right branch and a few drifting leaves. Preserve the single prominent yellow leaf in the boy's hand. Keep a restrained hint of warm rice fields at middle-right, without expanding them. No late-autumn orange forest. Retain the soft clear daytime light and fully detailed ivory cloth, without clipping or overexposure.
Absolutely no text, calligraphy, letters, numbers, watermark, UI border, panel, moon, rabbit or lantern. Do not move or enlarge the boy. Keep all head, fingers and both shoes within the frame. Output one independent completed wide banner.

visualReview.theme: First golden leaf raised by the boy, sparse drifting yellow leaves, mostly green foliage and a peach-and-pear basket; jade mountains and restrained golden rice fields suggest earliest autumn.
visualReview.style: Rounded chibi proportions, same golden headband, ivory/jade clothes, large brown eyes and gold yin-yang gourd; detailed soft painted volumes match references.
visualReview.face: Two coherent large eyes, intact face and smile; no visible distortion.
visualReview.hands: Two hands in natural grips; right fingers curl around leaf stem, left fingers contact basket. Some digits overlap or are occluded; no visible extra/fused digits, but not all five per hand can be independently counted.
visualReview.feet: Exactly two visible trouser legs and two shoes, fully inside frame, attached naturally to seated body.
visualReview.propContact: Leaf stem meets raised grip; basket supported by forearm/lap and gripping hand; hip gourd attached to waist.
visualReview.negativeSpace: Left 45 percent contains low-contrast lake, mountain silhouettes and mist; near buildings, dock, boat and bridge removed.
visualReview.textAndFraming: No visible text, watermark, pseudo-writing, UI controls, decorative border or collage.
visualReview.exposure: Ivory fabric retains folds, clouds and lake retain tonal detail; no broad clipped highlights observed.
visualReview.limitations: Visual asset review only; no client integration or whole-gallery audit.
visualReview.independentReview: A read-only second reviewer actually viewed final image and both references; passed theme/style, face, natural hand occlusion, two shoes, contact, quiet left area, no text/UI and exposure.

submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE final production-ready seasonal event banner illustration for the Chinese Taoist fantasy game 五行奇谈.
Canvas: very wide landscape banner, target 2098 × 749 pixels, aspect ratio 2.8:1. Opaque edge-to-edge painting. Output only the independent banner artwork, never a full UI, never a contact sheet.
Reference image 1 (event-midautumn.png) is the PRIMARY approved painted-art, character, finish and horizontal composition reference. Reference image 2 (01-mail-event.png) is the approved mail UI style/context reference only: do not render any of its frame, controls, labels, text or panels.
Faithfully keep the same refined rounded cute Chinese hand-painted fantasy art: clean polished outlines, rounded full forms, delicate painterly fabric/stone/foliage volumes, jade and teal mountains, ivory cloth, restrained warm gold details, clear depth, luminous but properly exposed highlights. This is richly finished 2D digital painting, not photorealism, not flat vector, not plastic 3D.
Main character stays on the RIGHT THIRD: same small chibi Taoist boy from reference, very large round brown eyes, round rosy face, short straight/spiky brown hair, pure golden headband with side knot and two ribbons, jade-green gold-trim vest over ivory short robe and trousers, golden yin-yang gourd, big head/short limbs. Adjust only his pose and the small seasonal props to the stated theme. Keep one boy only. All face, hands, and principal props stay within safe edges.
Composition: preserve the useful wide email-banner balance. Keep LEFT 45% relatively quiet with low-detail softly layered lake, mist, sky and distant mountains, suitable for future title overlay; do not draw any letters there. Character and the most legible seasonal emblems occupy the right, with sparse corner foliage. Keep the seasonal symbols visually distinct without crowding.
Text: absolutely no Chinese characters, no English, no pseudo-writing, no numerals, no calligraphy, no watermark, no logo, no graphic frame or UI border. No mooncakes, no giant moon, no Mid-Autumn lanterns, no rabbit; those are only in the style reference, not this season.
Rendering target: the project's configured highest quality visual finish; host-managed built-in tool, no claim that prompt text sets model parameters.
Season-specific scene: Beginning of Autumn solar term: the first gentle autumn breeze, mostly green trees with just a few amber and gold leaves drifting at the edges, clear soft blue sky over jade mountains and a quiet lake, faint warm gold in distant rice fields. On the right the smiling little Taoist boy holds a small woven basket of ripe peaches and a pale golden pear, with one tiny early yellow leaf resting by his golden gourd. Subtle transition from summer to autumn, not a deep-orange late-autumn forest.

Pose and anatomy refinement: The boy sits securely on a low rounded stone ledge on the right. He cradles the small peach-and-pear basket in his left forearm, with the left hand clearly gripping the basket rim; in his right open hand he gently presents one single first-yellow autumn leaf. Each hand has five anatomically coherent digits, with natural occlusion at the basket. Show exactly two short trouser legs and two small shoes fully within the frame. Golden yin-yang gourd hangs naturally at his hip. Keep fruit and basket visible and proportionate. Leave soft blue sky and mist over the quiet lake across the left 45 percent. A few amber leaves indicate the earliest change of season while the tree canopy remains mostly green. Native requested canvas is 2098 by 749 pixels; produce the closest supported native wide banner without padding, mockup framing or contact sheet.
